title: Firefly Pointillism — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: One light, many paths
scenes.purpose: Warm firefly points cluster into a light-bulb idea, accumulate along dotted routes into a network of node clusters, then a single sparse teal pulse travels from the bulb to one node.
visuals: Stationary dark navy radial field with faint static stars
Seeded hexagonal warm point cloud forming a light bulb and socket
Dotted warm routes linking five small node clusters
Single short teal pulse head with bright core and short trail
Title and kicker in the calm dark lower-left area

beats.development: Bulb points accumulate from the socket upward until the bulb silhouette is recognisable; warm halo rises; title fades in.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Points accumulate dot by dot along visible routes; node clusters gather where routes arrive; kicker settled.
With the system recognisable, one sparse teal pulse leaves the bulb and travels through the hub to the upper-right node, which turns teal.
Settled hold: full cluster, routes, lit node and copy readable.

findings: Form becomes recognisable (by ~0.95s) before the pulse starts at 1.6s, per the style timing rule.
Only one short teal segment is active at any time.
justifiedHolds: 2.64–3.0s settled hold for reading the title and lit endpoint.

notes: STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; the preview shows the core characteristic action (point accumulation along visible paths + sparse travelling pulse).
